title: Thai Leek Gratin
description: A Thai-inspired twist on the classic British gratin, featuring leeks and a nostalgic touch. This dish is perfect for a comforting evening meal.
instructions: Slice the leeks thinly and separate into individual rings.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tbsp of oil over medium heat. Add the leeks and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
In a separate saucepan, combine coconut milk, fish sauce, brown sugar, and grated ginger. Bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Stir in the flour to thicken the sauce. Season with salt and black pepper.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, create a layer of leeks. Pour some of the coconut milk mixture over the leeks.
Repeat the layering process two more times, finishing with a layer of leeks on top.
Sprinkle the grated cheddar over the top layer of leeks.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the gratin is heated through.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
